outcome: Impact of Pereira's suture on fertility
cohort: 50 women treated with Pereira's compressive sutures in a tertiary center
finding: Pereira's suture for postpartum hemorrhage had a 96% success rate and was associated with a low rate of complications, with no hysterectomies performed.
mod_finding: Women who had sutures performed during an intra-cesarean section had better outcomes than those who had an after-cesarean section.
